fields.Name: T288 - File Grid List/Grid View Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises FileGridComponent.toggleViewMode which swaps between two distinct template branches (viewMode==='list' table vs viewMode==='grid' tile layout) — a presentation-mode switch unique to the file grid, absent from the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: In the File Browser (open via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then 'Browse Files'), find the view-mode toggle (list vs grid/tile icons) on the right side of the file listing's bottom toolbar and click it to switch modes. Success is confirming the toggle RESPONDS — the active view button changes and, when files are present, the listing switches between a table/rows layout and a tile/grid layout. If the folder is empty or no account is configured, seeing the empty state persist without error is an acceptable pass. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A list/grid view-mode toggle control is present in the file listing toolbar and reacts to being clicked (active state changes)
The file display switches presentation between a rows/table view and a tile/grid view when files are present — OR the empty / 'No storage accounts configured' state persists cleanly
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
